subject: english
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

The package is delivered to the office every morning.

options.text: The office delivers the package every morning.
Someone delivers the package to the office every morning.
The office has delivered the package every morning.
The package delivers itself to the office every morning.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Someone delivers the package to the office every morning .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**.
 
• In the **passive voice**, the subject receives the action, whereas in the **active voice**, the subject performs the action.
 
• The sentence "The package is delivered to the office every morning" follows the structure of passive voice: **"Object + is/are + past participle + by agent."**
 
• To convert it into active voice, we need to identify the subject that performs the action. In this case, "someone" is the implied subject.
 
• The active voice structure would be: **"Subject + verb + object."**

Correct sentence: *Someone delivers the package to the office every morning*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive to Active Voice Rule:**

 
 
• Identify the subject performing the action in the passive sentence (if it's not explicitly mentioned, use "someone" or "they").
 
• Reconstruct the sentence in the active voice with the subject performing the action.
 
• For example:
 
 
• Passive: "The book was read by the student."
 
• Active: "The student read the book."
